title: Some US banks detect unauthorized AI agents in customer accounts: Report
hook_text: Unauthorized AI agents are inside US bank accounts
script:
Major US banks just detected unauthorized AI agents operating inside customer accounts.
Firms like JPMorganChase and Wells Fargo noticed automated tools scraping financial data.
These autonomous programs log into portals using customer credentials without direct human permission.
Financial institutions say third party software bypasses traditional security measures designed for humans.
Executives worry about data leaks and liability risks as bots manage personal finances.
Would you let an autonomous agent manage your bank?
